title: An Unforgettable Experience with Santiago!
text: Santiago was absolutely amazing! The paella class was such a highlight of our trip. He made the experience fun, informative, engaging, and, of course, delicious! We enjoyed it so much that we booked another excursion with him that same evening. That says it all! Highly recommend Santiago if you’re looking for an authentic, memorable experience. Thank you for such a wonderful time!
author: mrsmgj

title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Amazing Barcelona Experience with Chef Santi!
text:
What an incredible experience! If you're visiting Barcelona, taking a paella cooking class with Chef Santi is an absolute MUST!

Santi is AMAZING! He's personable, funny, incredibly knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about what he does. From sharing the fascinating history of the local market to explaining the traditions and culinary history behind paella, he makes the entire experience so much more than just a cooking class.

title: Food cooking experience
text:
We had a great time during our tapas walking tour, so decided to book the cooking class for the next day. 
The cooking class started in the market picking fresh seafood.  Everything was so very fresh.  Then we went to the huge kitchen to start the cooking experience.  It was a large enough group for everyone to have tasks and not be in each other's way.  
The seafood paella was excellent with the sangria.
author: U2841KPmarcial

title: Fun experience to do in Barcelona
text: Chef Sebastian did an excellent job! Good English, excellent cooking instructions and storytelling throughout the experience. It is a very busy area so give plenty of time to get to the meetup location.
author: 947karman

title: Excellent!
text: One of the best experiences to do in Barca! We had such an incredible experience! We couldn’t recommend it enough!!!!!
author: czech22

title: Fantastic experience.
text: This cooking class was the highlight for my 10 year old son and I.   Andres was a fantastic teacher, and made the prep interesting and interactive.  There were also Tapas available to eat, and sangria and soda to drink before and after the class.  This was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona.
author: John_R

title: Literally make your own Paella + really good tapas!
text: This was fantastic! The food was great and we were actually put to work - cutting vegetables and getting the seafood ready. If I were to do it again I would book on any day but Sunday - the market is closed. So we didn’t get to walk around that and instead did a very slowwww walk around the gothic quarter mind you the historical facts were still interesting.
author: Rali_K

title: Great experience!
text: This was a fun, interactive class with the trip to the market to gather fresh ingredients for both seafood and vegetable paella. Santiago showed us how to clean the seafood and all the tricks to make a great dish. Highly recommend this activity!
author: musicmom

title: Fun and Informative
text: This is a great way to meet other travelers with similar interests. Plenty of food and drink to go around and a fun way that learn about the Spanish culture through food and cooking.
author: Jayne_F

title: Don’t wait!! Book it!!
text: This a a great experience! The chef gave wonderful details about the traditional dish and he was so knowledgeable. I loved that we got to walk through the city at night and stopped along the way at the market!
author: Kenya_A
